SaaS Company, Kanata North (SR&ED Credit Recovery)<\/h3>

A Kanata North cybersecurity SaaS company had never claimed SR&ED in its first three years despite spending $480,000 annually on software development, threat detection algorithm design and automated penetration testing platform engineering. The founder assumed SR&ED was only for hardware R&D in a lab. Our review identified $1,440,000 in eligible expenditures across three years and filed T661 forms for each year.<\/p>

$504,000 SR&ED refund. 35% refundable credit on three years of eligible R&D.<\/div><\/div>\r\n
